fourth_correction: The 0273-design step-4 criterion ('K' - B_unk > 0 with |fluct| <= B_unk <=> certified exclusion'; printed in day072 line 348 and carried into the first 0274 wall record, the T4OffLM draft and this session's intermediate outputs) is a MISREADING of the discriminant and is WITHDRAWN. The sound face discriminant is the MEASURED fluctuation fluc := log|zeta(s)| - K' against the envelopes (three statements, all machine-verified below). The intermediate outputs out_day073_wall_3e10_split.txt ('UNIT A VERDICT: ... wall CONFIRMED (max K_opt - min B_opt < 0)') and out_day074_tslope.txt ('slope <= 0 -> the residual gap WIDENS') used the superseded criterion in their print labels; the NUMERALS in those files are correct and are re-read below with the sound criterion.
